title: Lust ready sound and screen flash
quote: I want to hear it the moment my group's Bloodlust comes back, so I can call the pull without staring at a bar.
what: When a lust provider's spell turns ready, play a short sound and flash the Essentials Bar row once. Options let you pick the sound and turn it off per spell.
possible: Partly on Retail and WoW: Forever (only for players running the addon; Forever has no lust). Possible on Classic Era, TBC and MoP for everyone.
today: Today: Essentials shows READY in green, no sound or flash

title: Next lust countdown on one line
quote: I just need one number: how long until I can lust, from anyone in the group.
what: A single compact line (or tiny icon) showing the soonest-ready lust and who holds it, for example 'Lust: Kaelen 0:42'. It can be shown instead of the whole Essentials Bar.
possible: Partly on Retail, TBC and MoP (lust exists; Retail needs the other player to run the addon). Not possible on Classic Era and WoW: Forever (no lust).
today: Today: Essentials lists every provider on separate rows

title: Lust exhaustion and active lust timer
quote: After the lust goes out I want to see the 40 seconds left and when Sated or Exhaustion drops off.
what: Show a small timer for the lust buff on you, and a Sated style debuff timer, so you know when burst is over and when a second lust is allowed.
possible: Partly on Retail (own player auras are readable by known spell ID, other players are not). Possible on TBC and MoP. Not possible on Classic Era and WoW: Forever (no lust).
today: Today: only the lust spell cooldown is tracked

title: Power Infusion tracker for the priest next to you
quote: I'm asking my priest for PI and I need to know whether it's actually up before I line up trinkets.
what: A dedicated PI line showing which priest has it and whether it is ready, with a one-click whisper or macro text asking for it. Hidden when the group has no priest.
possible: Partly on Retail and WoW: Forever (priest must run the addon; Retail's tracked list does not include PI today). Possible on MoP, TBC and Classic Era via combat log.
today: Today: PI is in the MoP, TBC, Era and Forever lists only, not Retail, and has no special line

title: Burst window planner
quote: I want my trinkets and big cooldowns to line up with lust and PI, not guess.
what: Show your own big cooldowns beside the group's lust and PI timers, and mark a green window when they overlap. You tick which of your own spells count as burst.
possible: Partly on Retail and Forever (group timers only from addon users, and combining times in combat may hit hidden values; own cooldowns are fine). Possible on Classic Era, TBC and MoP.
today: Today: group list and lanes only, nothing combines them with your own burst

title: Group defensives filtered by what hurts the next hit
quote: When the boss does a raid hit I want to see who still has Aura Mastery or Anti-Magic Zone, not scroll a long list.
what: A quick filter that shows only raid-wide defensives (AMZ, Barrier, Darkness, Rallying Cry, Spirit Link) and hides single-target and utility rows. Toggle with a slash command or keybind.
possible: Possible on every client, using the same tracked spells with a category flag.
today: Today: you can untick spells in settings, but not switch views quickly

title: Compact icon-only mode
quote: My screen is full already, give me icons and a timer, no names and borders.
what: A panel style that shows just spell icons with a swipe timer and a small class-coloured dot, packed in a tight grid. Works in 20-man raids without eating the screen.
today: Today: rows with text, class stripe and a lane view, sizes only by scale and opacity

title: Auto-hide in combat or on bosses only
quote: I don't need it open during trash, but I want it up on every boss pull.
what: Options to show the panel only in combat, only on boss encounters, or only out of combat, plus fade to low opacity when nothing is about to come up.
possible: Possible on every client (group and encounter state are already known).
today: Today: shown when in a group, toggle by hand

title: Raid-size cheap mode
quote: In 25-man I don't want an addon eating frames while I'm trying to hit my rotation.
what: A setting that slows the 0.5 second refresh, drops hidden rows, and pauses the panel while you are not looking at it. Shows the cost in the debug command so players can check.
today: Today: fixed 0.5 second refresh and no per-addon cost readout

title: Dead or offline provider warning
quote: If my lust shaman is dead, I need that fact now, not when I press the button.
what: Mark a provider's row grey with a skull when the owner is dead, offline or out of range, and show the next live provider instead.
possible: Possible on every client (death and connection state are readable for group members).
today: Today: provider shows ready even if the owner is dead
